title: REQ · Furniture and object grids exist at declared sizes
summary: Desk, computer, lamp, plant, poster, bookshelf, bed, door and rug grids
description: Context: furniture is placeholder SVG. Desired behavior: grids with outlines and ramp shading for desk (80x32), old computer (30x34), lamp (16x30), plant (20x32), poster (28x36), bookshelf with books and globe (48x96), bed with patterned blanket (104x40), door (40x80) and rug (80x24), plus a ROOM_SOURCES list combining the shell and furniture. Expected result: nine more ArtSources at declared sizes with palette indices only. Why: completes the set SG-2.2 and SG-2.3 consume.
acceptance_criteria: Given each furniture source, when measured, then it equals its ROOM_ART_SIZES size
Given the bookshelf, then it has wood indices plus at least two non-wood ramp indices for books and a globe; given the bed, then it has at least two blanket pattern ramp indices
Given ROOM_SOURCES, then it has 13 unique ids covering every key of ROOM_ART_SIZES
